class.name: limo_inflation::BorderFollowLayer
class.description: Creates a zero-cost band at the preferred distance from obstacles and a bounded cost field on either side while preserving source-map costs.

class.name: limo_inflation::LocalLaneLayer
class.description: Applies the two-lane border-follow cost profile to the fused local sensor costmap. Run last, after obstacle and semantic layers.

class.name: limo_inflation::GaussianLayer
class.description: Gaussian inflation with configurable covariance and maximum combination. Run last, after sensor fusion.

class.name: limo_inflation::PathDistanceLayer
class.description: Bounded additive distance cost around the global path. Run after obstacle inflation; preserves lethal, inscribed and unknown cells.
